dependencyDashboardHeader:
Renovate updates for this cluster. Nothing is merged automatically: review each PR and merge it into `k0s`, then Flux deploys it.

- Merge the `flux-cli` update before `fluxcd/flux2` (gotk-components.yaml is generated with that CLI).
- Forgejo chart updates open as draft PRs: check for a recent Longhorn backup, then mark ready and merge.
- Major updates: read the release notes before merging.

packageRules.description: Never automerge Kubernetes and Helm dependencies
Flux controller images are upgraded together with the Flux CLI (flux install --export), not image by image
Don't track resource apiVersions (HelmRelease helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2, CronJob batch/v1, ...): they fill the dashboard and almost never update
Renovate itself has thousands of releases; building release notes for a multi-major jump pegs a CPU for ~40 minutes on every run
Renovate regenerates gotk-components.yaml with the flux binary copied from this image, so the fluxcd/flux2 update stays empty until this one is merged
prBodyNotes: Merge this first: the fluxcd/flux2 (gotk-components.yaml) update is generated with this flux CLI and only produces changes once it runs the new version.

packageRules.description: Delegate this digest-only OCI source to the version-aware custom manager; Flux ignores ref.tag when ref.digest is set
Stay on the Forgejo 15 LTS line: every chart 17.x ships Forgejo 15.0.x (17.0.0=15.0.0 ... 17.3.2=15.0.11). Chart major is not app major, so check appVersion before allowing chart 18
Hold Nextcloud for storage and application audit
